visualCharacteristics.purpose: Boxed notice, disclosure or callout with optional image or icon

contentPattern.structure: One or more rows; a cell that holds only an image or icon becomes the media, all other cells become the body (heading, text, links). The last stand-alone link is treated as the call to action

usage: Investment disclosures, benefit intros, icon callouts, PDF reader notes and inline cross-sell notices
reuseGuidance: Pick contact/blue for centered intro panels, note for an eyebrow heading between rules, icon-callout or with-icon when an icon leads the text, with-image for image + text notes.
